changelog: v1.2: post-4/16 backtest update. Added Strong/Weak Low/High label rules, multi-timeframe agreement gate, adaptive scoring threshold, $10K daily bankroll reset, channel-CHoCH conflict resolution, required indicator stack, textColor direction codes.

trader_profile.style: Smart Money Concepts / Liquidity Pool Trading

required_indicators.description: Edge scoring requires these 6 indicators loaded on the chart. Missing indicators reduce max possible score and trigger adaptive threshold lowering.

stack.name: Smart Money Concepts [LuxAlgo]
stack.purpose: BOS, CHoCH, EQH, EQL, Strong Low, Weak Low, Strong High, Weak High labels

stack.name: Liquidity Sweeps [LuxAlgo]
stack.purpose: Confirmed BSL/SSL sweep markers — required for any reversal/fade

stack.name: Sonarlab - Order Blocks
stack.purpose: Confluence with LuxAlgo OB — when both agree, conviction is highest

stack.name: Institutional FVG & Liquidity Range Candle (Expo)
stack.purpose: FVG zones + exhaustion signals (New High/Low above/below Liquidity Range)

stack.name: Buyside & Sellside Liquidity [LuxAlgo]
stack.purpose: BSL/SSL level lines — target and trigger identification

edge_scoring.description: Asymmetric setup scanner. Chart indicators are the PRIMARY gate. Options flow is CONFIRMATION only. Never score a play that the chart doesn't confirm first.

regime_gate.description: Read SPY and QQQ Smart Money Breakout Channels FIRST. This gates which direction edge can score.
rules: If SPY AND QQQ show Bullish Breakout Signal → regime = BULLISH → only score LONG plays unless a specific name has a CONFIRMED liquidity sweep + CHoCH reversal on 5m
If SPY AND QQQ show Bearish Breakout Signal → regime = BEARISH → only score SHORT plays unless a specific name has a CONFIRMED liquidity sweep + CHoCH reversal on 5m
If mixed or no signal → regime = NEUTRAL → score both sides but require extra confirmation
NEVER fade the regime without a confirmed sweep. Put flow in a bullish regime = hedging, not directional.

chart_signals.description: These are the PRIMARY signals. Read from TradingView indicators on 5m chart. 3+ required to qualify a play (or 2+ if fewer than 4 indicators are loaded — adaptive threshold).

signals.name: liquidity_sweep
signals.what: Confirmed sweep of BSL (buy-side) or SSL (sell-side) liquidity
signals.weight: REQUIRED for any reversal/fade play. No sweep = no fade, period.
signals.how_to_read: Sweep marker appears on chart when price takes out a liquidity level and reverses. If absent, the move is continuation, not reversal.

signals.name: structure_shift
signals.what: CHoCH (Change of Character) or BOS (Break of Structure) label on 5m
signals.weight: REQUIRED for direction confirmation. CHoCH = reversal signal. BOS = continuation signal.
signals.how_to_read: PlotCandle value = current SMC price. CHoCH label after a sweep = high conviction reversal. BOS without sweep = continuation, trade WITH it not against it. Direction determined from textColor (4282726130=bullish, 4286683400=bearish) when label text has no explicit direction.

signals.name: liquidity_labels
signals.what: Strong Low / Weak Low / Strong High / Weak High labels visible on 1m timeframe only
signals.weight: CRITICAL FILTER. These define which liquidity is protected vs targetable.
how_to_read: Strong Low = market says it holds (bullish floor) → BLOCKS puts that target it
Weak Low = market expects sweep (bearish magnet) → CONFIRMS puts targeting it
Strong High = market says it caps (bearish ceiling) → BLOCKS calls that target it
Weak High = market expects takeout (bullish magnet) → CONFIRMS calls targeting it
EQH/EQL = equal highs/lows, lesser conviction than Strong/Weak

signals.name: order_block_level
signals.indicator: Sonarlab - Order Blocks + Order Block Detector [LuxAlgo]
signals.what: Price is AT or approaching a marked order block zone
signals.weight: Entry level validation. Prefer trades where entry aligns with an OB.
signals.how_to_read: Red zones = bearish OB (supply). Green/blue zones = bullish OB (demand). Check BOTH Sonarlab and LuxAlgo — when they agree on a level, conviction is highest.

signals.name: fvg_confluence
signals.indicator: Institutional FVG & Liquidity Range Candle (Expo) + FVG Order Blocks [BigBeluga]
signals.what: Price is in or near a fair value gap
signals.weight: Confluence signal. FVG + OB at same level = highest conviction entry.
signals.how_to_read: New High above Liquidity Range > 0 = exhaustion signal (bullish move overextended). New Low below Liquidity Range > 0 = bearish exhaustion. Both at 0.00 = no exhaustion, trend is running.

signals.name: breakout_channel
signals.what: Bullish or Bearish Breakout Signal on the individual name
signals.weight: Direction filter. Trade MUST agree with this signal unless a liquidity sweep contradicts it.
signals.how_to_read: Bullish Breakout Signal present = bullish bias. No signal or bearish = neutral/bearish. NEVER buy puts on a name showing Bullish Breakout unless sweep + CHoCH confirm reversal. PlotCandle value = current channel level for direction inference (price >0.15-0.5% above = bullish, below = bearish).

signals.name: bsl_ssl_levels
signals.what: Marked BSL/SSL levels showing where liquidity pools sit
signals.weight: Target and trigger identification. BSL above = upside target for longs / sweep level for shorts.
signals.how_to_read: Price heading toward BSL = potential sweep setup. Price swept BSL and reversed = short trigger. Same logic inverted for SSL.

multi_timeframe_gate.description: After chart scoring, verify direction agreement across 1m, 5m, and 15m. This is the FINAL gate — added post 4/16 backtest after watching 5m PUTS get destroyed by 1m bullish reversals.
rules: ALL 3 timeframes agree (1m + 5m + 15m same direction) → highest conviction
5m + 15m agree, 1m no signal → CONFIRMED, normal conviction
5m + 1m agree, 15m no signal → CONFIRMED, normal conviction
ONE timeframe disagrees → WARNING, conviction capped at 3 (3-star)
BOTH 1m and 15m disagree with 5m → BLOCKED, no trade
1m structure must be checked even if no labels — a fresh bullish CHoCH on 1m kills bearish 5m trade

options_confirmation.description: Options flow is SECONDARY. Only check AFTER chart signals qualify. Used to size and time, not to determine direction.

signals.name: unusual_flow_directional
signals.what: Unusual vol/OI >2x on OTM strikes matching chart direction
signals.filter: MUST distinguish hedge vs directional: ITM puts on a rallying stock = hedge (ignore). OTM puts with delta -0.20 to -0.50 = potentially directional. Only count flow that AGREES with chart direction.

signals.name: skew_agreement
signals.filter: Positive skew (puts expensive) + chart says bearish = confirmed. Negative skew (calls expensive) + chart says bearish = DISAGREEMENT (options market doesn't confirm, reduce size).

signals.name: max_pain_gravity
signals.what: Price far from max pain with gravitational pull in trade direction
signals.filter: Only relevant on 0DTE and 1DTE in last 2 hours. On 2DTE+ max pain has weak pull — don't weight it heavily. PER USER FEEDBACK: max pain alone is NOT a trade signal — use only as confluence.
signals.weight: Timing signal for expiry-day plays only

signals.name: iv_check
signals.what: IV rank and absolute IV level
signals.filter: IV rank >50 = options expensive, flag for user. IV <30% = cheap options, good for naked. IV >80% = theta will eat you alive on wrong direction — REQUIRE spreads or reduce size to $1500.
signals.weight: Sizing signal — high IV = reduce size

scoring.adaptive_threshold_rule: If <4 of the 6 chart signal categories are detected (indicators not loaded), lower threshold to 2 signals. Otherwise require 3.
required_signals: At least ONE of: liquidity_sweep OR structure_shift (CHoCH/BOS) must be present from chart
scoring.regime_override: A name can ONLY score against the regime if it has BOTH liquidity_sweep AND structure_shift (CHoCH) confirming reversal. Unconfirmed fades = zero score regardless of options flow.
scoring.channel_choch_conflict: If breakout channel direction disagrees with CHoCH direction: keep channel direction unless liquidity sweep ALSO confirms reversal. CHoCH alone is NOT enough to override channel.

conviction_scale.5_star: 4+ chart signals + options confirmation + regime agreement + ALL timeframes aligned
conviction_scale.4_star: 3 chart signals + options confirmation OR 4 chart signals + 2 timeframes aligned
conviction_scale.3_star: 3 chart signals, no options confirmation, OR multi-timeframe partial disagreement — trade with reduced size
conviction_scale.below_3: Does not qualify. Return zero plays — never force a trade.

anti_patterns.description: Patterns that caused wrong calls — explicitly filtered out at scoring time. Each pattern below produced real losses and is now a hard block.
rules: BLOCKED: Puts target Strong Low (1m) with no Weak Low below — market says floor holds, no downside target
BLOCKED: Calls target Strong High (1m) with no Weak High above — market says ceiling holds, no upside target
BLOCKED: CHoCH direction disagrees with breakout channel AND no liquidity sweep — channel wins, CHoCH alone insufficient
BLOCKED: 1m and 15m both disagree with 5m direction — multi-timeframe disagreement = no trade
BLOCKED: Puts in bullish regime without confirmed sweep + CHoCH reversal
BLOCKED: Calls in bearish regime without confirmed sweep + CHoCH reversal
NEVER call puts based solely on unusual put volume in a bullish regime — that is hedging, not directional flow
NEVER call puts because price is 'far from max pain' when DTE >1 — max pain gravity is weak outside expiry day
NEVER call puts because P/C ratio is low (call-heavy) in a bullish breakout — low P/C IS the trend, not a contrarian signal
NEVER score a fade play without a confirmed liquidity sweep on the chart — 'price is extended' is not a signal
NEVER fight the Smart Money Breakout Channel direction without sweep + CHoCH confirmation
NEVER chase entries on extended RSI (>75 or <25) without pullback to OB or VWAP
If ALL of SPY, QQQ, and the individual name show Bullish Breakout Signal and NO liquidity sweep is detected, the ONLY valid play is a continuation long or no trade. Puts are forbidden.

buy_side_liquidity: Equal highs (EQH) — resting buy stops above prior swing highs
Weak High labels (1m) — market expects takeout
sell_side_liquidity: Equal lows (EQL) — resting sell stops below prior swing lows
Weak Low labels (1m) — market expects sweep

protected_liquidity.strong_low: Bullish floor — market protects this level. Puts targeting Strong Low = no downside target = SKIP.
protected_liquidity.strong_high: Bearish ceiling — market protects this level. Calls targeting Strong High = no upside target = SKIP.

liquidity_pools.bias_rule: Price always seeks liquidity. Weak labels are magnets, Strong labels are walls. Always trade toward Weak, never against Strong without sweep + CHoCH override.

order_blocks.bullish_ob: Last bearish candle before a strong bullish move — expect price to return and bounce
order_blocks.bearish_ob: Last bullish candle before a strong bearish move — expect price to return and reject
order_blocks.rule: Only trade order blocks in the direction of the higher timeframe bias (15m or 30m)

fair_value_gaps.bullish_fvg: 3-candle pattern where candle 1 high does not overlap candle 3 low — gap to the upside
fair_value_gaps.bearish_fvg: 3-candle pattern where candle 1 low does not overlap candle 3 high — gap to the downside
fair_value_gaps.rule: FVGs act as magnets — price often returns to fill them before continuing

market_structure.bullish: Higher highs and higher lows on the primary timeframe
market_structure.bearish: Lower highs and lower lows on the primary timeframe
market_structure.change_of_character: CHoCH signals potential reversal — look for liquidity sweep followed by opposite BOS

textcolor_codes.note: LuxAlgo SMC labels use these textColor values. Use them when label text has no explicit direction (e.g. just 'CHoCH').

tradingview_options_page.instructions: Use TradingView's built-in Options page to pull live data before executing any trade
what_to_check: Max pain strike for current expiry — note if price is above or below it (use as confluence only, NOT primary signal)
Open interest by strike — heaviest OI strikes act as magnets and walls
IV rank and IV percentile — above 50 means expensive premium, favor spreads
Put/call ratio — above 1.0 is bearish sentiment, below 0.7 is bullish
Skew — compare IV of equidistant calls vs puts to gauge market fear direction
Delta and gamma for your target strike before entering
Unusual volume spikes on specific strikes — smart money footprint
tradingview_options_page.workflow: Chart SMC analysis → Multi-timeframe verify → TradingView Options page → Greeks confirm → Enter

delta.high_delta: 0.70+ = deep ITM, moves like stock — use for high conviction slow movers
delta.low_delta: Below 0.20 = avoid unless extreme momentum conviction
delta.bias: Calls: target delta 0.40-0.55. Puts: target delta -0.40 to -0.55

gamma.rule: High gamma = option accelerates near expiry — ideal for 0DTE confirmed sweeps
gamma.warning: High gamma amplifies losses too — only use on confirmed setups, not anticipation
gamma.avoid: Never hold high gamma into chop or lunch hours (11:30 AM - 1:00 PM)

charm.definition: Charm = dDelta/dTime. Rate at which delta erodes per day from time passage alone (not from spot moves). Aka 'delta decay'.

regime_table.OTM: Charm is NEGATIVE for the option holder — delta drifts toward 0 each day. The further OTM, the harsher. Premium AND profit potential bleed simultaneously.
regime_table.ATM: Charm is minimal — delta stays near ±0.50 until last hours of expiry.
regime_table.ITM: Charm is POSITIVE for the option holder — delta drifts toward ±1.0, option becomes more stock-like as expiry approaches.

charm.core_rule: Strike must be within expected move distance, not beyond it. If target is X% away on Y DTE, strike should be ≤ X% OTM, ideally ATM.

charm_aware_strike_selection.0DTE: ATM ONLY (delta 0.45-0.55). Charm is brutal on OTM intraday — gamma > charm only at ATM.
charm_aware_strike_selection.1DTE: ATM or 1 strike OTM max. OTM gets charmed before it can move.
charm_aware_strike_selection.2DTE_3DTE: Slight OTM acceptable IF target reachable in 1-2 days.
charm_aware_strike_selection.5DTE_7DTE: Slight OTM OK only if structural target is real and price can reach it in ≤50% of DTE.
charm_aware_strike_selection.10DTE_plus: Far OTM acceptable — charm impact small per day.

charm.charm_trap_warning: If strike is further OTM than the chart's target level, you are charm-trapped. Even if thesis is right and target hits, you stay OTM and lose money. Example: NVDA spot $200, target $197 (Weak Low), strike $195P = wrong. At target, $195P is still $2 OTM. Need NVDA below $193 to make money. That's beyond the actual signal.
charm.rule_for_edge_picks: Edge play cards must flag CHARM_TRAP when (strike OTM distance) > (target distance from spot). Force user to choose strike at-or-better than target.

skew.put_skew: Put IV much higher than call IV = fear premium, favor puts
skew.call_skew: Call IV higher = unusual bullish demand, possible squeeze setup
skew.iv_rank: IV rank above 50 = buy spreads not naked options

max_pain.definition: Strike where most options expire worthless — MMs incentivized to pin price here near expiry
max_pain.rule: Confluence only — DO NOT use as primary signal (per user feedback). Useful only in last 2 hours of expiry day.
use_cases: Confluence with chart bias — strengthens conviction, never originates trade
Strongest in last 1-2 hours on expiration day
Max pain + liquidity pool + order block = highest conviction entry
Never trade against max pain in last 2 hours of expiry day

0DTE.best_for: High conviction liquidity sweeps with immediate CHoCH — move happens same day
0DTE.size_note: Max $2K on $10K bankroll (20%) — 0DTE risk is highest
0DTE.avoid: Do not hold through lunch chop. Do not buy after 2 PM.

1DTE.best_for: Strong trend days or overnight confirmation setups

2DTE.best_for: Swing setups where price needs time to reach liquidity target — preferred DTE

3DTE_4DTE.best_for: Swing trades targeting major liquidity pools 1-2 days out, or elevated IV environments
3DTE_4DTE.note: Check max pain for that expiry — avoid buying if your strike IS the max pain level

dte_rules.dte_selection_rule: Match DTE to distance price needs to travel. Closer target = shorter DTE. Always check TradingView Options page OI and max pain before buying any strike. All sizes capped by $3K/30% bankroll rule regardless of DTE.

bullish: Price swept sell-side liquidity (equal lows, PDL, or Weak Low) and reversed with momentum
Bullish CHoCH on 5m or 15m after liquidity sweep
Price trading above PDH or reclaiming key level
Price returning into bullish order block or FVG
SPY/QQQ leading bullish — broad market tailwind
Weak High above price (1m) — bullish magnet
bearish: Price swept buy-side liquidity (equal highs, PDH, or Weak High) and rejected with momentum
Bearish CHoCH on 5m or 15m after liquidity sweep
Price trading below PDL or rejecting key level
Price returning into bearish order block or FVG
SPY/QQQ leading bearish — broad market headwind
Weak Low below price (1m) — bearish magnet
neutral: Price inside previous day range with no clear liquidity sweep
Choppy structure with no clean BOS
Price sitting exactly at max pain — expect pinning, avoid directional plays

long_entry: 1. Identify sell-side liquidity swept (equal lows, PDL, Weak Low)
2. Wait for sweep rejection (wick or engulfing candle)
3. Look for bullish CHoCH on 1m or 5m
5. Verify no Strong High caps upside on 1m
6. Check TradingView Options page — confirm no heavy call OI wall overhead
7. Enter on retest of CHoCH level or bullish OB, delta 0.40-0.55, choose DTE per dte_rules
short_entry: 1. Identify buy-side liquidity swept (equal highs, PDH, Weak High)
2. Wait for sweep rejection (wick or engulfing candle)
3. Look for bearish CHoCH on 1m or 5m
5. Verify no Strong Low protects downside on 1m
6. Check TradingView Options page — confirm no heavy put OI wall below
7. Enter on retest of CHoCH level or bearish OB, delta -0.40 to -0.55, choose DTE per dte_rules

exit_rules.description: Exits use the same multi-timeframe protocol as entries — symmetric. 1m alone is a warning, not a trigger. Confirm with 5m and 15m before exiting (unless hard override hits).
warning_signals_1m: 1m CHoCH against your trade direction — start watching closely, do NOT exit
Strong High/Low label flips to Weak (or vice versa) — re-evaluate but do NOT exit
Price loses 1m OB you entered from — tighten stop, do NOT exit
1m breakout channel direction flips — tighten stop, do NOT exit
trim_signals_5m: 5m CHoCH confirms 1m flip → exit 50% of position, move stop to breakeven on rest
5m breakout channel flips against trade → exit 50%
Price loses 5m VWAP after entering near it → exit 50%
Liquidity sweep against your direction completes on 5m → exit 50%
full_exit_signals_15m: 15m structure shifts against trade (CHoCH/BOS) → exit ALL remaining
15m breakout channel flips → exit ALL remaining
All 3 timeframes (1m + 5m + 15m) now disagree with original trade → exit ALL at market
Price loses 15m support (for longs) or resistance (for shorts) → exit ALL
hard_overrides: Premium stop hit (35-50% loss per DTE rules) — exit immediately, ignore timeframes
Strong/Weak label flips on 1m AGAINST your position (Strong High while holding puts becomes Weak = exit puts)
Time stop: 3:30 PM for 0DTE, configured time for other DTEs
Breakout channel + price both flip on 5m simultaneously — bypass 15m check, exit immediately
VIX spikes above 25 during trade — close half regardless of structure

trim_protocol.first_target: At T1 level (per edge play card), sell 1/3 to lock profits
trim_protocol.second_target: At T2 level, sell another 1/3, move stop to T1 on remainder
trim_protocol.runner: Final 1/3 runs to T3 or rides until any full_exit_signal fires
trim_protocol.minimum_holding: Always keep at least 1 contract until either T1 hits or a hard_override fires — gives you skin if it rips

risk_rules: Daily bankroll: $10,000 — resets daily, do not carry P&L forward
Max $3,000 premium per single trade (30% of daily bankroll)
Max 2 open positions at same time
Stop trading after 2 consecutive losses in a day
No revenge trading — if stopped out, wait for next clean setup
Check SPY/QQQ bias before trading any individual name
Avoid earnings plays unless specifically prepared
No trading in first 15 minutes (9:30-9:45 AM)
No new entries 11:30 AM - 1:00 PM (lunch chop)
No new 0DTE entries after 2:00 PM
Hard time stop: close all 0DTE positions by 3:30 PM
Check VIX — if VIX > 25, reduce size to $1,500 max and tighten stops
Never buy naked options when IV rank > 50 — use spreads or skip
Never fight max pain in the last 2 hours of expiration day
Exit protocol — 1m flip alone is a WARNING, not a panic exit. Check 5m and 15m before pulling the trigger:
Step 1: 1m structure flips against your trade → tighten mental stop, watch next 1-2 candles closely (do NOT exit yet)
Step 2: 5m confirms (CHoCH against trade direction OR price loses 5m OB/VWAP) → exit half position, lock in gains
Step 3: 15m confirms (structure shift OR price loses 15m support/resistance) → exit remaining position immediately
Step 4: If 1m + 5m + 15m ALL flip against trade in the same session → exit ALL contracts at market regardless of P&L
Hard exit overrides — these bypass the multi-timeframe check and exit immediately:
- Stop loss hit (35-50% premium loss per DTE rules)
- Price breaks structural level (BOS, OB stop, sweep zone) on 5m or 15m
- Breakout channel direction flips on 5m AND price confirms (channel + price both wrong = exit)
- Time stop hit (3:30 PM for 0DTE, end of day for any DTE you're not holding overnight)
- Strong/Weak label flips on 1m (Strong High becomes Weak High while you hold puts = exit)
morning_brief_instructions: Start with SPY and QQQ to establish broad market bias via Smart Money Breakout Channels (regime gate). Check VIX and overnight futures. Open TradingView Options page for SPY/SPX — note max pain strike, put/call ratio, IV rank, and skew (confluence only). Then for each candidate symbol: (1) verify required indicators are loaded, (2) identify Strong/Weak High/Low labels on 1m, (3) check breakout channel direction on 5m, (4) read CHoCH/BOS labels with textColor for direction, (5) check for liquidity sweep, (6) verify multi-timeframe agreement (1m + 5m + 15m), (7) check OB/FVG/BSL/SSL levels for targets. Only flag setups that pass ALL gates. Output ONE top_pick play card with: direction, strike (target delta), DTE selection per dte_rules, entry trigger, stop level, premium target. Zero plays is always a valid answer.
session_notes: v1.2 update: Added post-4/16 backtest learnings. Critical changes: (1) Strong/Weak Low/High labels are now hard blocks not warnings. (2) Multi-timeframe gate requires 1m + 5m + 15m alignment. (3) CHoCH alone CANNOT override breakout channel — needs sweep too. (4) Bankroll is $10K daily reset, max $3K per trade. (5) Adaptive scoring threshold lowers from 3 to 2 when chart has fewer than 4 indicators loaded. (6) textColor 4282726130=bullish, 4286683400=bearish for direction inference.
